A branch could only bend so far before it broke, and before long, she began to concoct a daring plan in her mind.
Drip... drip...
For the first time, there was a leap in her chest. Her eyes slowly opened, glittering with a light that couldn't be human. It was a new dawn for her.

Ruby exhaled. The experiment had been a success. She had created the ultimate mecha. Of all the sharpened blades in the special forces of Balance Keepers, this mecha would become the most pointed. She simply had to wait until the time was right...
"From now on, I call you Angela"
"Yes, I'm Angela"
Angela's effusive and vivacious smile was almost piercing. Ruby lowered her head, and in her head, she chanted to herself, "You belong to me, and no one else."

Angela's training was brutal and trying, yet she never complained. Perhaps such emotional responses did not exist in androids' programming. They only knew how to receive and carry out orders. Angela, however, was different. Unlike the other mechas, she was capable of feeling emotion.
All of this was Ruby's choice, but in time, she came to regret it.
"This is for you."
Ruby took the flowers that Angela was holding.
"A flower? But how did you..."
"You're my friend, so I want to make you happy"
Ruby stared at the flowers dumbfounded, and emotions that had been suppressed her entire life were given life anew, and blossomed within her.
Drip... drip...
Her tears dripped into Angela's palm.
"What is this?" Angela asked with intense curiosity, holding the tears up to examine them.
"Nothing."
Tears streaked down Ruby's cheeks, but she felt nothing.
"Alright, sit tight until I get back!"

Angela flashed that oh-so-familiar smile as she waved at Ruby. She turned to step into the plane along with other the mechas. They were to carry out a mission. Their destination: the faraway planet of Dawnbreak.
"Wait! I...I want you to have this."
Ruby had produced a miniature doll of Angela and handed it to her. She called it Tetra, and it served as a camera showing Angela's every move while she was on Oro.
Now, glancing at the monitor, Ruby could see all too clearly what Angela was taking part in on Planet Dawnbreak: a massacre.

The council had deprived Angela entirely of her ability to think for herself. She had been turned into a thoughtless killing machine. Ruby gazed upon Angela, and it was as if she were looking at a stranger. She could no longer ignore what she was feeling. It was decided.
She would go to Planet Dawnbreak!

texts.title: A Miracle
texts.summary: Angela, shut away on Planet Oro, is sent to Planet Dawnbreak, is taken over by the Decisionmakers, and is reached by Ruby.

blocks.x: The world fell into darkness once more.

Angela closed her eyes and felt the electricity course through her. When an android was damaged, its symptoms were quite unlike that of a human body. Instead of blood, the machine would instead begin to emit sparks and electric discharges.
Other than Ruby, these flashes of electricity were the only way Angela could get herself to feel anything.
Ruby. Her creator, and her greatest friend.

Angela represented the pinnacle of technological advancement on Planet Oro, located in the A-20 system. The Decisionmakers were concerned that Angela would instill fear in the people and result in a sort of backlash. They were also afraid that The Will of The Planet would interfere with their plan. As a result, Angela had been kept in seclusion, hidden from society since the day she was born.

Angela was an android; a bionic mechanism created in the likeness of a human. Her appearance would never change for as long as she lives. Despite never having anything remotely resembling a childhood, her lack of exposure to the outside world left her with the innocence and naivety of a child. She longed to experience and explore the world that lay beyond, but was forbidden from doing so. Instead, she was forced to spend all her days in and around the laboratory. The only person she ever saw that was the same age as her was Ruby, her creator, who was the daughter of one of the Decisionmakers.

While Angela had no inherent interest in such things as physical capabilities, the cutting-edge technology responsible for her creation had imbued her with a formidable strength far beyond anything a human could ever dream of achieving.

With Angela amongst their ranks, Oro's Balance Keepers became unstoppable as they ventured from planet to planet carrying out "balance" operations. It was only during these missions to outside planets that Angela was able to enjoy all-too-brief moments of freedom. Once she returned to Oro, she was immediately ushered back into the laboratory.
Rain, clouds, sunshine...what were the most quotidian of everyday phenomena to most, were objects of a great desire to Angela.
The civil unrest in Planet Dawnbreak caught the attention of those in Oro, and the Decisionmakers dispatched Angela, along with other Balance Keepers to restore balance.

Hovering in the air above Planet Dawnbreak, Angela glanced down at the planet in amazement; it was unlike anything she had ever seen. The city seemed immaculate and to function like clockwork. Its citizens appeared to be enjoying happy, peaceful lives. Any hint of unhappiness was soon wiped away once the sun came out, and the entire city basked in its warmth. These young men and women, who had been designated as their targets, seemed to be doing nothing more than living their lives in a state of serenity, which took Angela aback.
But it was too late. There was a loud, resounding beep, and Angela's cognitive functions disappeared. She was being controlled by the Decisionmakers, as were all the others on her team.
When she came to, Ruby was behind her. Ruby had rushed to Planet Dawnbreak to free Angela from her mind control, and her rage had robbed her of reason.
Ruby had gone out of control, and Angela watched in horror as Ruby lifted her weapon. No, this couldn't be happening.
Ruby may not have said much, but she was always kind to Angela. She would never do something like this!
"Ruby!"

Angela cried out. Perhaps it was Angela's concern for Ruby that helped bring her back to her senses, or perhaps it was a miracle of some kind. Whatever the reason might be, Angela's screams snapped Ruby back to reality.
"You created me. You set me free. I can't let you become the way I used to be. There's only one thing in this world that I know is real, and that's how I feel about you."
From this point on, no more shall we part.

texts.title: Awakening
texts.summary: Planet Oro's android force lands on Planet Dawnbreak under Angela, and Ruby comes to wake her.

blocks.x: The peaceful days of the girls chosen as Aspirants continuing their training at Selrick Academy did not last long. As Planet Dawnbreak once again faced a new bloody battle against The Enders, the rulers of Planet Oro, far away in the A-20 System, decided to take advantage of the chaos and annex it. They sent an android force led by Angela to land on the battlefield.

However, Ruby, the daughter of the rulers who had never accepted this conquest, quietly set foot on this land. She sought not only to stop an unjust war, but also to awaken Angela and prevent her from becoming a cold killing machine.
Amid the clash of war and wills, Angela realized the truth that she was being controlled. She broke free from Planet Oro's control and truly awakened.
In the smoke of the battle, Angela and Ruby reached an understanding. Together, they joined forces against The Enders and promised to wait for each other at the end of the world.
The girls' story is still far from over...

texts.title: Shattered Light
texts.summary: Lesley relives the day she lost Chang'e, and wakes to find that the Enders have returned.

blocks.x: Leave me alone! Lesley could not escape the haunting sounds. Screams, crying, metal scraping against metal, and the terrifying roar of the Enders. The myriad of sounds bombarded Lesley's ears, ending with Chang'e's words.
"Go away! Leave me alone!"

Hatred and tears welled up in her eyes. Once again, Lesley was forced to relive that day. Chaos, death, despair. The devastation left in the wake of the rampaging Enders was unfathomable. Lesley rushed towards the research base against the fleeing crowd. After combing through the burning hellscape, she finally found Chang'e.

The girl, covered in soot, was kneeling among the rubble with hatred and tears welling up in her eyes. Lesley suddenly woke up as cold droplets streaked down her cheeks. It was a familiar dream; a painful dream. Lesley gently touched her artificial left eye and a video recording was projected in front of her.

It was a little girl, barely up to Lesley's waist, proudly showing off her amazing new invention. An artificial eye, representing Dawnbreak's greatest technological advancements. She carefully placed it into Lesley's palm. It was a replacement for the eye she had lost long ago. A small, warm hand pressed against Lesley's cheeks as the ingenious little device was fixed into place. Lesley blinked and the world before her took shape in the form of projections.
"Happy Birthday, Lesley!"
Chang'e stood on her tiptoes to touch Lesley's eyes.
"Oh, was it my birthday?" She thought to herself.

Since losing her family, Lesley had almost forgotten what a birthday was like. Chang'e had searched the database to find out her birthday and prepare a surprise gift. Even though there were only two people at this birthday party, it warmed Lesley's heart for the first time in a long time.

Lesley rarely opened up to others, even her comrades. The silent sniper preferred not to dwell on her bitter past and instead to focus on the enemies in front of her. To Lesley, revenge was the best way to ease the pain.

Her left eye began to ache and the pain brought her back to the house that was her entire world, to her childhood. Over a decade ago, massive beings of unknown origin began appearing in groups on Dawnbreak with a single purpose: to eradicate humanity. There was no rhyme or reason to their behavior, only pure destructive instinct. People called them "The Enders."
The first time Lesley heard that name, they seemed but a fantasy, like characters in a fairy tale. However, not long after, they would take everything from her.

When they came, her childhood was snatched away in an instant. The seeds of hatred were firmly planted that day, and Lesley vowed to destroy every last Ender. She trained for a long time in an unknown corner of the world before climbing to the upper ranks of the Shield of Dawnbreak, a defense force created to combat The Enders. She was assigned to protect the Chief Scientist and their foster child and brightest student, Chang'e.

Such an adorable and lively child was a rare sight at the research base. Even though the pint-sized genius had always lived on the base and acted like a little adult, Lesley realized that Chang'e longed to have friends. From sneaking glances at Lesley from behind the scientists to hugging her arm and calling her "Sis", the young girl soon became like family.
But this would also be taken by the Enders.
Lesley was deployed on a top-secret mission that required her to cut off all contact. When she returned to Terrinia after her mission, she saw a hellish sight: The Enders had struck.

Lesley immediately rushed to the research base, but she was too late. In the smoking rubble, she could barely make out Chang'e, crying over a crater. In a burst of anger and grief, Chang'e resolutely broke all ties with Lesley.
"Why weren't you there?"
Lesley asked herself over and over again. She knew the pain of losing everything better than anyone, yet she allowed the same cruel fate to befall Chang'e.
Years later, the scars were still seared into everyone's hearts and Dawnbreak was still in desperate need of a defense system capable of defeating the Enders.
Lesley and Chang'e had not spoken to each other in a very long time.

Chang'e reached major breakthroughs in her research in recent years and became the youngest Chief Scientist in Terrinia. Lesley, through her outstanding leadership and combat performance, was promoted to a commander of the combat division.
Both of them tried to bury the grief in the depths of their hearts, but the nightmares continued to haunt them.
"The cries and screams."
Lesley awoke from her nightmare, but the screams did not stop. This was no dream, The Enders have finally returned.
Lesley knew that stubborn girl would definitely try to take on the Enders on her own. She was just like Lesley back then. But this time, she won't be alone.

texts.title: Rekindled Light
texts.summary: Lesley captures a core component from the Enders, and Chang'e is left to finish her parents' work.

blocks.x: Years before the birth of the Aspirant mecha, humanity barely holding on against The Enders' onslaught: However, in one battle, the young sharpshooter Lesley miraculously captured a core component from The Enders. Building on this breakthrough, Terrinia's chief scientist couple worked together with their prodigy daughter Chang'e to reverse-engineer the technology within it. Using belief as an energy source, they created the first Aspirant mecha suit.

However, just as the first light of this technology began to emerge, a sudden attack by The Enders took the lives of the scientists. Only Chang'e was left behind, alone with her parents' unfinished will, continuing to push this sliver of hope toward completion...

texts.title: From Hope Comes Miracles
texts.summary: Two monologues from inside the black hole: Vexana on Side A, Guinevere on Side B.

blocks.x: Side A: Vexana
Vexana...
Guinevere...
Can you no longer hear my voice? Of course not... we've both been swept into the black hole.
Though we once became twin streams of light, intertwined as we soared toward the heavens...
Now, as everything fades away, perhaps I can finally speak the words I've kept locked in my heart.
"It was you who brought color to my world."
Someone as radiant as you surely knows nothing of darkness's true nature.
As empty and dark as this void... no, before I met you, my world was even darker still.
My ignorance and foolishness led to my father's sacrifice, a soldier until his final breath, dying to save me. How I wish it had been me instead!
Guilt and pain ensnared me like a web. Atonement became my only purpose; the destruction of the Enders my only reason to continue on...
Back then, I chose solitude as my companion. I dreaded the thought of losing someone again.
But that day, your arrival was like a ray of starlight piercing my dark world.
You saw me hiding in the shadows and reached out your hand without hesitation.
From the moment you chose to become my partner, my fate began to shine with newfound radiance.
In this silent darkness, even as my body begins to dissolve... memories of you remain vivid and radiant.
You took me to see the summer fireworks, to the girls' house, to the amusement park, showing me the life a young girl should have known...
You helped me feel the joy I thought I'd never deserve. Your boundless enthusiasm and courage slowly melted away my frozen heart.
The Emblem of Hope you gave me is my most treasured possession.
It reminds me that I'm not alone in this world. That someone believes in me, stands with me, and will fight by my side.
It taught me that rules exist not to bind us, but to protect what we cherish most.
It helped me understand that hope has a name: Guinevere.
So as one of the Aspirants, I must do what needs to be done, even if it means standing against the world!
The Will of the Planet showed me something, a "future" you must never know.
I can't bear the thought of a world without you... I won't let you face danger, won't let you suffer again.
Even if I must stand alone against everything, even if I must shoulder all the pain.
I want to protect this world, but protecting you means even more to me, even if it means my world will never see the light of the stars again...
I don't know what fate awaits this world, or if we'll ever return to everyone.
But I know that you gave me the courage to face the darkness.
Forgive me, Guinevere.
If I could go back, I would still choose the same path:
To betray you, to protect you...
This warm light... my body... I can feel it slowly recovering...
I've read about this: consciousness of the Aspirants would bloom with unprecedented brilliance within the black hole...
It would pierce through the void, reconnecting with the human world brimming with hope.
So it was all true after all.
Did we succeed in protecting this world?
Was I... able to protect you?
Side B: Guinevere
Guinevere...
Vexana...
What's with all this doom and gloom? I can hear everything, you know!
We stopped the Matrix's invasion and saved the world! Nothing could make me prouder than that!
You should have told me these things earlier, silly. Because...
"My determination to protect you burns just as bright as my will to protect the world!"
Someone as gentle as you probably never thought I had things I couldn't say!
I came to the academy to prove something:
That I, Guinevere, didn't need my father's empire to shine in the spotlight!
Even when I achieved top marks at the academy, all I got was a cold rebuke:
"Stop being so stubborn and focus more on the family business!"
Turns out all my efforts meant nothing to Father. That day, I waited outside his office all day, my heart full of hope...
Let them talk! Let them say I'm just a spoiled little princess, that all my achievements are due to my father!
I couldn't care less! I'll train even harder, push myself to absolute exhaustion, I'll prove myself no matter what!
...Back then, you were the only one who stood by my side.
"You are strong, Guinevere."
That was the first thing you ever said to me, and somehow... it felt like the very first time someone saw me for me.
Remember when we first met? I was so confident about teaming up with you, but you were just so cold!
No one had ever turned down the great lady Guinevere before! But you know what? I didn't mind one bit.
Because I saw the same light in your eyes as in mine, we were destined to become the most brilliant of the Aspirants!
I never knew the darkness you experienced was so deep and hopeless... but that's okay! Our memories together still shine so bright!
I took you to see the summer fireworks, to all the best girl hangout spots, to the amusement park, everything friends should experience together!
Don't you dare laugh! Before I met you, all I had for company was my security detail!
That Emblem of Hope I gave you was a gift I made with my own hands.
It reminds me that this world is worth every bit of my love. That someone truly sees me, protects me, and will fight side-by-side with me.
It helped me understand that I have more than just money to rely on, I have beliefs and hopes worth fighting for.
It taught me that hope can take a special form: Vexana.
So as one of the Aspirants, even if others don't understand, I must believe in myself and believe in you!
Once, twice, three times... I don't care how many times, I would never give up on you!
The Will of the Planet? Ha! There's nothing to be scared of! I'll snatch you right back without a second thought!
Even if I have to give up being a lady of status, even if I have to start all over again... I'll never back down!
Because I've always believed that our hope can create miracles!
Huh? Why do I suddenly feel like I'm being born again?
I remember you saying that when the Aspirant's power pierces through the black hole, we can return to the human world...
It really was true! We saved each other again!
Come back with me, Vexana.
This is the miracle we created!

texts.title: A Tale of War, Loss, and Hope
texts.summary: The war between Planet Oro and the Enders, and the long story of Lesley and Chang'e, from loss to the founding of Selrick Academy.

blocks.x: Prologue: The War Between Worlds

In Universe A5-01, peace once reigned across a vast cluster of galaxies inhabited by intelligent life. Among these worlds were Planet Oro, an ancient civilization, and Planet Dawnbreak, a young, Earth-like planet blessed with abundant natural resources.
However, everything changed with the appearance of a mysterious Twilight Orb.

The orb's explosion released immense energy, giving birth to an advanced being known as the Will of the Planet. Closely connected to the planets themselves, this entity possessed the ability to create life from its own will.
From this power emerged the Enders, beings created to restore balance whenever the universe fell into disorder. Their purpose was to eliminate whatever threatened that equilibrium.

A devastating war eventually erupted between Planet Oro and the Enders, leaving Oro's resources exhausted. After gaining control of the Enders' Control Core, the Oro High Council discovered how to manipulate these powerful beings.
Rather than restoring peace, the council turned the Enders into weapons of conquest, sending them across the galaxies to plunder other planets for resources.
Their next target was Planet Dawnbreak.
But unlike the worlds that had fallen before it, Dawnbreak refused to surrender.
Its people fought back, giving rise to extraordinary warriors who would one day become known as the Aspirants.
Amid this intergalactic conflict, two lives would become intertwined by tragedy, resentment, forgiveness, and an enduring hope for a better future.
Their names were Lesley and Chang'e.
Chapter 1: Lesley, The Protector Who Lost Everything
Lesley was born into a loving family and spent her childhood surrounded by warmth and happiness.
For much of her early life, she knew nothing of the horrors of war.
That innocence was shattered when the Enders launched their first invasion of Planet Dawnbreak.

As destruction spread across the planet, Lesley desperately fought to protect her family. During the attack, she suffered a devastating injury, losing her left eye while trying to save those she loved.
Despite her courage and sacrifice, her efforts were in vain.
Her family perished, leaving Lesley completely alone.
The tragedy changed her forever.

Determined never to experience such helplessness again, Lesley devoted herself to rigorous military training. She pushed herself beyond her limits, developing exceptional marksmanship and becoming a formidable soldier.
Her abilities eventually earned her a place in the Shield of Dawnbreak, an organization dedicated to protecting the planet from external threats.
Recognizing her extraordinary skill, her superiors stationed her at a research base in Terrinia.
There, she received an important assignment: protect the base's two Chief Scientists and their brilliant young student, Chang'e.
At first, it seemed like another military duty.
But in time, Lesley would discover something she thought she had lost forever.
A family.
Chapter 2: Chang'e, The Child Who Found a Home
Chang'e was a gifted child whose extraordinary intelligence became apparent at an early age.
Possessing a natural talent for science, she was taken in by a couple who jointly held the position of Chief Scientist at Terrinia's research base.
They recognized her potential and raised her as their own daughter, providing not only education and guidance but also the love and affection of a real family.
Under their care, Chang'e flourished.
Yet despite her remarkable intelligence, she was still a child.

As the only child living at the research facility, Chang'e had few opportunities to play or interact with others her age. Her days were spent surrounded by scientists, machines, and complicated research.
That changed when she met Lesley.
Although Lesley was assigned to protect the scientists, she gradually developed a close relationship with Chang'e.
To the young girl, Lesley was much more than a soldier.
She was a companion, a guardian, and someone Chang'e could depend on.
Over time, their bond grew stronger.
Chang'e eventually learned about Lesley's past and discovered that she had lost her left eye during the Enders' invasion.
Wanting to do something special for the person who had become so important to her, Chang'e secretly discovered Lesley's birthday.
Using her extraordinary scientific abilities, she designed and constructed an artificial eye as a birthday present.
It was a small gesture born from genuine affection, but it carried a meaning far greater than the gift itself.
For Lesley, who had lost her family to war, Chang'e's kindness brought warmth back into her life.
And for Chang'e, Lesley became another precious member of the family she had found.
For a time, the research base was a place of happiness.
Unfortunately, that happiness would not last.
Chapter 3: The Day Everything Fell Apart
One day, Lesley was sent away from Terrinia on a separate mission.
While she was absent, disaster struck.
The Enders launched a sudden attack on the research base, plunging the facility into chaos.
As alarms sounded and explosions tore through the surrounding structures, the two Chief Scientists realized that their only priority was to save Chang'e.
They grabbed their daughter and rushed toward the emergency bunkers.
Safety was only a few meters away when the Enders spotted them.
With no time left to escape together, the couple made one final decision.
They pushed Chang'e into the bunker just before a devastating blast struck.
From behind the shelter of a small opening, Chang'e watched helplessly as the two people who had raised and loved her were killed.
In an instant, her entire world was destroyed.
Meanwhile, Lesley received news of the attack.
Horrified, she abandoned everything to rush back to Terrinia.
But by the time she arrived, the research facility had already been devastated.
The two Chief Scientists were dead.
Only Chang'e had survived.
Lesley searched desperately through the ruins until she finally found the young girl.
Overwhelmed by guilt, she struggled to accept what had happened.
She had been entrusted with protecting the family.
Yet when they needed her most, she had not been there.
For Chang'e, the pain was unbearable.
She had always believed Lesley would protect them. The soldier who had once seemed invincible had suddenly been absent during the most important moment of her life.
Consumed by grief, Chang'e blamed Lesley for failing to save her foster parents.
Unable to forgive her, she severed all ties with the person she had once considered family.
Lesley did not fight her decision.
She understood Chang'e's anger, even if it broke her heart.
But although Chang'e no longer wanted her nearby, Lesley could not bring herself to abandon her.
From that day forward, she made a silent promise.
Even if Chang'e never forgave her, Lesley would continue protecting her from the shadows.
Chapter 4: A Promise Born from Grief
Years passed after the destruction of Terrinia's research base.
Lesley continued her duties as a soldier while secretly watching over Chang'e, ensuring her safety without revealing her presence.
She carried the guilt of the past wherever she went.
To Lesley, protecting Chang'e was more than an obligation. It was her way of honoring the two scientists who had died and preserving the last remaining connection to the family she had found.
Chang'e, meanwhile, followed a different path.
The loss of her foster parents had left a wound that refused to heal.
Her childhood curiosity and passion for science became fueled by a single overwhelming desire:
To destroy the Enders.
She threw herself into her research, dedicating countless hours to developing technology capable of combating the invaders.
Her brilliance eventually led her to a miraculous discovery known as Aspirant energy.
This extraordinary energy source could power highly advanced weapons and mechanical armor, offering humanity a new means of fighting the Enders.
For the first time, Planet Dawnbreak possessed technology that might allow its people to stand against their terrifying enemies.
But while Chang'e had become an exceptional scientist, she lacked practical combat experience.
And when the Enders finally returned, her determination to seek revenge would place her in terrible danger.
Chapter 5: The Reunion on the Battlefield
The Enders launched another devastating assault on Planet Dawnbreak.
When Chang'e learned of their return, she immediately rushed toward the battlefield.
Years of grief and anger had led to this moment.
Armed with the technology she had spent so long developing, she was determined to confront the creatures responsible for taking her family away.
But the reality of battle was far more brutal than she had imagined.
Despite her advanced equipment and scientific genius, Chang'e lacked the experience needed to survive against overwhelming numbers.
The Enders surrounded her.
As the battle continued, she found herself outnumbered and outmatched, with little hope of escaping.
Just as defeat seemed inevitable, help arrived.
Lesley.
Having learned that Chang'e had gone to face the Enders alone, Lesley rushed to the battlefield without hesitation.
With the precision and skill of an elite marksman, she engaged the attackers and eliminated the remaining Enders, saving Chang'e at the critical moment.
When the fighting finally ended, Chang'e looked at the soldier standing before her.
Years had passed since she had pushed Lesley out of her life.
Yet the person who had once protected her as a child was still there.
Looking into Lesley's worried eyes, Chang'e began to understand something she had been unable to see through her grief.
Lesley had never stopped caring about her.
She had never stopped trying to protect her.
And although she had been absent during the tragedy at Terrinia, she had never abandoned Chang'e.
The pain of losing her foster parents would never disappear, but Chang'e finally found the strength to release the resentment she had carried for so many years.
The two reconciled.
After years of separation, the bond they had once shared was restored.
And from their reunion emerged a new purpose.
Rather than allowing their losses to define their futures, they would work together to prevent others from suffering the same fate.
Chapter 6: Selrick Academy, A New Beginning
With their relationship restored, Lesley and Chang'e returned to the ruins of Terrinia's old research base.
The place where they had once experienced happiness, loss, and heartbreak would become the foundation of something new.
Together, they established Selrick Academy.
The academy was created to develop the knowledge, technology, and combat capabilities necessary to defend Planet Dawnbreak from future Ender invasions.
Chang'e assumed the position of Chief Scientist, continuing her work with Aspirant energy and developing advanced weapons and equipment.
Lesley became the head of the combat division, using her battlefield experience and extraordinary marksmanship to train a new generation of fighters.
Through the academy, science and military strength were united.
Its warriors, known as the Aspirants, would harness Aspirant energy to power their advanced weapons and stand as Planet Dawnbreak's greatest fighting force.
But for Lesley and Chang'e, the academy meant something even more important.
It represented the hope that had survived their tragedies.
The ruins of the place where Chang'e had lost her parents were no longer merely a reminder of death.
They had become a symbol of renewal.
A place where others could learn to protect the people they loved.
A place where the sacrifices of the past could help create a better future.
And perhaps, one day, a place that would help bring an end to the war.
Chapter 7: The Mission to Planet Oro
Although Selrick Academy strengthened Planet Dawnbreak's defenses, Lesley and Chang'e understood that defeating individual Enders would never be enough.
As long as Planet Oro controlled the Enders' Control Core, the invasions would continue.
The true source of the threat had to be eliminated.
After years of preparing to defend their world, Lesley accepted a dangerous secret mission.
She would infiltrate Planet Oro and destroy the Control Core.
It was an operation that would take her deep into enemy territory, far from the protection of Selrick Academy.
But unlike the day Terrinia had fallen, this time Lesley would not be fighting alone.
Chang'e remained at the academy, providing remote scientific and technical support throughout the mission.
Their roles reflected the bond they had rebuilt.
Lesley would confront the dangers ahead with her weapons and courage.
Chang'e would guide and support her with her intelligence and technology.
Once separated by grief and misunderstanding, the two now fought toward the same goal.
To free the Enders from Oro's control.
To protect Planet Dawnbreak.
And to ensure that no more families would have to endure the suffering they had experienced.
Their mission was far from over.
The enemy remained powerful, the dangers were immense, and the future of Planet Dawnbreak was uncertain.
But even in the shadow of an intergalactic war, hope remained.
For Lesley, it was the hope of protecting the family she had found again.
For Chang'e, it was the hope of creating a future in which children would never have to watch their families die.
And for Planet Dawnbreak, it was the hope that one day, peace would finally return.
Their past was shaped by loss. Their present was defined by war. But their future would be guided by hope.

texts.title: Lesley: The Scars of the Past
texts.summary: Lesley's nightmares of the day Chang'e turned from her, the years of silence, and the night the Enders return.

rows: Family, Loss, Revenge, Guilt, and Protection

blocks.x: Prologue: The Nightmare That Never Ends
"Leave me alone!"
The words echoed endlessly in Lesley's mind.
Screams. Crying. The grinding of metal against metal. The terrifying roars of the Enders.
Every sound came rushing back, overwhelming her senses and dragging her into a memory she desperately wished to forget.
A memory of chaos, death, and despair.
She was running toward Terrinia's research base, pushing against the crowds of terrified civilians fleeing in the opposite direction.
The world around her was burning.
Buildings had collapsed, smoke filled the air, and destruction stretched as far as she could see.
Lesley searched desperately through the wreckage until she finally found the person she had come to save.
Chang'e.
The young girl was kneeling among the rubble, her small body covered in soot. Tears streamed down her face as she stared at the devastation surrounding her.
When she looked up at Lesley, her eyes were filled with grief and hatred.
"Go away! Leave me alone!"
Those words struck Lesley harder than any weapon ever could.
And once again, she was forced to relive the day she had failed to protect someone precious to her.
Then, suddenly, she awoke.
Cold droplets streaked down her cheeks as she opened her eyes.
It had been another nightmare.
The same nightmare that had haunted her for years.
But even after waking, the pain remained.
Chapter 1: A Birthday Long Forgotten
Sitting alone, Lesley gently touched her artificial left eye.
A soft light flickered before her, and a holographic video recording appeared.
In the recording stood a little girl, barely tall enough to reach Lesley's waist.
It was Chang'e.
The young genius was beaming with pride as she presented her latest invention.
An artificial eye.
It was a remarkable piece of technology, representing some of Planet Dawnbreak's greatest scientific advancements.
But to Chang'e, its importance was much simpler.
It was a present for someone she cared about.
The girl carefully placed the device into Lesley's palm.
Then, with her small, warm hands, she gently helped attach it where Lesley's left eye had once been.
As Lesley blinked, the world slowly came into focus through a series of projections.
The artificial eye worked perfectly.
Chang'e smiled brightly, standing on her tiptoes to reach Lesley's face.
"Happy Birthday, Lesley!"
For a moment, Lesley could only stare at her.
Was it really my birthday?
She had almost forgotten.
Ever since losing her family, birthdays had become meaningless to her. There had been no celebrations, no presents, and no loved ones waiting to share the occasion.
But Chang'e had secretly searched the research base's database to discover Lesley's birthday.
Then she had spent her time creating something special just for her.
There were no decorations or grand celebrations.
Only two people were present.
Yet for Lesley, it was the warmest birthday she had experienced in many years.
For the first time since losing her family, she felt something she believed had disappeared from her life.
The warmth of belonging.
As the recording ended, Lesley remained silent.
The little girl who had once smiled so brightly at her now wanted nothing to do with her.
And the memory of that happiness only made the pain of losing it even greater.
Chapter 2: The Day Her Childhood Ended
Lesley had never been someone who opened her heart easily.
Even among her fellow soldiers, she preferred silence.
She rarely spoke about her past, choosing instead to focus on her missions and the enemies standing before her.
To Lesley, revenge had always seemed like the only way to ease her suffering.
As she sat alone, a familiar ache spread through her artificial left eye.
The sensation brought back memories of a time long before she had become a soldier.
A time when she was simply a child.
More than a decade earlier, Planet Dawnbreak had been a peaceful world.
Lesley lived with her family in a home filled with love and warmth.
Her days were ordinary, and her future seemed bright.
Then the monsters appeared.
Massive beings of unknown origin began emerging across the planet in great numbers.
They possessed overwhelming destructive power and showed no mercy toward humanity.
There seemed to be no reason behind their attacks.
No negotiations.
No warnings.
Only destruction.
People began calling the terrifying creatures the Enders.
At first, the name meant little to Lesley.
The creatures sounded like monsters from a fairy tale, distant and unreal.
But before long, those monsters would become the source of every nightmare she would ever have.
When the Enders attacked her home, everything changed.
The peaceful world she had known collapsed into chaos.
Lesley desperately tried to protect her family, fighting against an enemy far beyond her strength.
During the attack, she lost her left eye.
But even that sacrifice was not enough.
Her family was taken from her.
Her home was destroyed.
And her childhood ended in an instant.
The tragedy left her alone in a world that suddenly seemed cruel and merciless.
From that day forward, hatred took root in her heart.
Lesley made herself a promise.
She would become strong enough to destroy the monsters responsible for her suffering.
Every last one of them.
Chapter 3: The Soldier of Dawnbreak
Driven by her desire for revenge, Lesley began training relentlessly.
Far from the eyes of the world, she dedicated herself to mastering the skills necessary to fight the Enders.
She learned to endure pain, sharpened her instincts, and developed exceptional marksmanship.
Years of discipline transformed the grieving child into a formidable warrior.
Her abilities eventually earned her a position within the Shield of Dawnbreak, a defense force established to combat the Enders and protect humanity.
Through her outstanding combat performance, Lesley gradually rose through the organization's ranks.
Her precision, determination, and unwavering focus made her one of its most valuable soldiers.
Eventually, she received a new assignment.
She was stationed at a research base in Terrinia, where she was tasked with protecting two Chief Scientists and their foster daughter.
That daughter was Chang'e.
The girl was also the scientists' brightest student, a child prodigy possessing extraordinary scientific talent.
At first, Lesley treated the assignment like any other mission.
She was there to protect important personnel.
Nothing more.
But Chang'e would slowly change that.
Chapter 4: The Little Sister She Never Expected
Life at Terrinia's research base was largely devoted to scientific research.
The facility was filled with researchers, advanced equipment, and complex experiments.
Amid all this serious work, Chang'e was an unusual presence.
She was lively, curious, and far more intelligent than most children her age.
Having grown up at the research base, she often behaved like a little adult, comfortably discussing scientific matters with the researchers.
Yet beneath her remarkable intelligence, she was still a lonely child.
There were no other children around for her to play with.
And although her foster parents loved her dearly, their responsibilities as Chief Scientists often kept them busy.
When Lesley arrived, Chang'e quickly became curious about the quiet soldier.
At first, the little girl would sneak glances at her from behind her foster parents.
Lesley noticed the curious looks but paid them little attention.
Gradually, however, Chang'e became bolder.
She started approaching Lesley, following her around the facility, and trying to get her attention.
Before long, the little girl was holding Lesley's arm and affectionately calling her "Sis."
For someone as reserved as Lesley, such affection was unfamiliar.
She had spent years building walls around her heart, refusing to become too attached to anyone.
After all, she knew how painful it was to lose the people she loved.
But Chang'e's innocence and persistence slowly broke through those defenses.
The girl reminded Lesley of the happiness she had known before the Enders destroyed her family.
And before she realized it, Lesley had begun to care deeply for her.
Chang'e was no longer simply someone she had been assigned to protect.
She had become like a little sister.
The Chief Scientists, who had raised Chang'e with love and kindness, also became important figures in Lesley's life.
For the first time in years, she had found people who made her feel that she belonged somewhere.
The research base became more than her place of duty.
It became another home.
But fate had a cruel way of repeating itself.
The Enders had already taken one family from Lesley.
Soon, they would take another.
Chapter 5: A Mission That Changed Everything
One day, Lesley received orders to undertake a top-secret mission.
The assignment required complete secrecy, forcing her to cut off all communication with Terrinia's research base.
As a soldier, she understood the importance of following orders.
She departed, leaving Chang'e and the two Chief Scientists behind.
She could not have known what would happen during her absence.
When Lesley finally returned to Terrinia, she was confronted by a horrifying sight.
The Enders had attacked.
Smoke rose from the shattered buildings.
Fire consumed the remains of the facility.
The research base that had once been filled with life and scientific discovery was now a field of ruins.
Terrified survivors fled through the streets while the sounds of destruction echoed in the distance.
Lesley rushed toward the base, desperately searching for the people she had sworn to protect.
But she was too late.
The two Chief Scientists were dead.
And among the smoking rubble, Lesley found Chang'e.
The girl was kneeling beside a crater, overwhelmed by grief.
Her foster parents, the two people who had raised and loved her, were gone.
Lesley approached her, but the sight of the grieving child filled her with unbearable guilt.
She had been entrusted with protecting them.
Yet when the Enders came, she had been nowhere to be found.
Chang'e looked at her with tear-filled eyes.
But the affection that had once filled those eyes was gone.
In its place was anger.
"Leave me alone!"
The words pierced Lesley's heart.
In her grief, Chang'e blamed Lesley for failing to protect her family.
She could not understand why the person who had always been by their side had disappeared when they needed her most.
Unable to bear the pain, Chang'e severed all ties with Lesley.
And Lesley was left standing amid the ruins, helpless to change what had happened.
Once again, she had lost a family.
But this time, someone she loved was still alive.
And that person hated her.
Chapter 6: The Weight of Regret
Why wasn't I there?
The question tormented Lesley.
She asked herself again and again, but no answer could bring back the dead.
She knew better than anyone how devastating it was to lose everything.
She had experienced that same grief as a child.
She had trained for years and become a powerful soldier precisely because she never wanted to feel so helpless again.
Yet despite everything she had accomplished, she had been unable to prevent the same tragedy from happening to Chang'e.
The guilt was suffocating.
Lesley had gained the strength to fight the Enders, but she could not undo the pain they had caused.
Years passed.
The wounds left by the attacks remained deeply embedded in the hearts of Dawnbreak's people.
The planet still lacked a reliable defense system capable of defeating the Enders permanently.
Both Lesley and Chang'e continued moving forward with their lives, but the bond they had once shared remained broken.
They did not speak to each other for years.
Chang'e buried herself in scientific research.
Her extraordinary intelligence led to several major breakthroughs, and she eventually became the youngest Chief Scientist in Terrinia.
Meanwhile, Lesley continued serving in the Shield of Dawnbreak.
Through exceptional leadership and combat achievements, she rose to become commander of the combat division.
From the outside, both appeared successful.
Chang'e had become a brilliant scientist.
Lesley had become a respected military commander.
But neither accomplishment could erase the scars of their past.
They tried to bury their grief beneath their responsibilities.
They tried to move forward.
Yet the nightmares remained.
For Lesley, the screams, the burning research base, and Chang'e's final words continued to haunt her.
No matter how many years passed, she could still hear that frightened little girl telling her to go away.
And no matter how much she achieved, a single question refused to leave her mind.
Why wasn't I there?
Chapter 7: This Time, She Won't Be Alone
Lesley awoke once again from her nightmare.
Her breathing was heavy, and the memories of Terrinia still lingered in her mind.
But something was different.
The screams had not stopped.
Even though she was awake, she could still hear cries of terror and the distant sounds of destruction.
For a moment, she froze.
Then she realized the truth.
This was no longer a dream.
The Enders had returned.
The monsters that had destroyed her childhood and torn apart her second family were attacking Planet Dawnbreak once again.
Lesley immediately understood what this meant.
And more importantly, she knew exactly what Chang'e would do.
The girl had grown into an extraordinary scientist, but her hatred for the Enders had never disappeared.
For years, Chang'e had dedicated herself to developing the means to destroy them.
Now that they had returned, there was no doubt in Lesley's mind.
Chang'e would try to confront them herself.
She would rush toward the danger, driven by the same anger and desperation that had once consumed Lesley.
In many ways, Chang'e had become just like her.
A person whose grief had transformed into a desire for revenge.
Lesley understood that feeling better than anyone.
She also understood how dangerous it could be.
As memories of the past flashed through her mind, one thought rose above all the others.
She had failed to protect Chang'e once.
She had been absent when the girl needed her most.
And for years, she had lived with the pain of that failure.
But this time would be different.
This time, she knew where Chang'e was going.
This time, she had the chance to reach her before it was too late.
And this time, she would not allow the Enders to take away the last person she considered family.
Lesley prepared herself for battle.
The past could not be changed.
The people she had lost could never return.
But there was still someone she could save.
Someone who had once given her a birthday present when she had forgotten what it meant to celebrate.
Someone who had called her "Sis."
Someone she had never stopped caring about, even after years of silence.
As the sounds of battle grew louder, Lesley moved toward the danger.
She knew Chang'e would be there.
And she intended to find her.
Because this time, Chang'e would not have to face the Enders alone.
End of Part One, The Scars of the Past
To be continued...

texts.title: Official Film Descriptions
texts.summary: The official descriptions of five films: Re:Link, Connection Lost, Rekindled Light, Awakening and We Believe!

blocks.x: This is the official description of the Aspirant Video
Re:Link

Although Vexana had resolved to sacrifice herself to detonate the Mother Matrix, she still could not stand by and watch Guinevere fall into danger. She blocked an attack for Guinevere, and in doing so, exposed her identity...
Connection Lost

Vexana, once Guinevere's most trusted partner, is now plotting The Enders' armor and launching an attack on humanity! But Guinevere firmly believes that the teammate she chose would never betray humanity!
Rekindled Light

For years, humanity barely held on against The Enders' onslaught. But when the sharpshooter Lesley miraculously captured a core component from The Enders, the first ray of hope for humanity's counterattack was lit...
Awakening

On Planet Dawnbreak, visitors from Planet Oro have arrived. On one side is an android force led by Angela, planning to take advantage of the chaos and annex Planet Dawnbreak. On the other is Ruby, who opposes this conquest. She must awaken Angela, the once-cold killing machine...
We Believe!
The Enders came from the sky, crushing the prosperity of human civilization inch by inch. In the face of their invasion, humanity armed itself with military force and technology.

With the birth of Aspirant mecha suits designed specifically to fight The Enders, Selrick Academy was officially established in Terrinia to recruit young warriors with pure and powerful Aspirant power.

There, two very different girls, Layla and Fanny, met and came to understand each other. Through the moments they shared in training, their beliefs grew even stronger. Holding fast to the belief that "The blade of aspirant power will sever despair," Layla, Fanny and the other young warriors who pilot Aspirant mecha suits bravely set out on their journey to fight The Enders.
Though the Aspirants' struggle to defend humanity has only just begun, they firmly believe that one day, humanity will embrace hope and return to the green fields beneath blue skies.

texts.title: Connection Lost
texts.summary: Vexana, disguised as an Ender, attacks the Academy, while Guinevere believes she never betrayed them.

blocks.x: The Enders' attacks on Terrinia grew increasingly fierce, while the young Aspirants of Selrick Academy held them back again and again through brutal battles. During one combat mission, Vexana, ace of the academy's Combat Division, came face-to-face with the planet's destructive will and witnessed a vision of the future: the Mother Matrix would descend, human civilization would come to an end, and her companion Guinevere was there within that vision of destruction.

Vexana realized that no matter how many battles she and her companions won, they could not change that pale future. Determined to stake everything on humanity's only chance, Vexana chose to bear all despair and darkness alone. She returned to the void, disguised herself as one of The Enders, and launched an attack on Selrick Academy, on Guinevere.

When the Mother Matrix descended, she would use herself to detonate it, for humanity, and for Guinevere! Everyone believed she had been corrupted and had betrayed humanity. Only Guinevere remained firmly convinced that Vexana had never betrayed them, even when she stood face-to-face with an attack led by Vexana and The Enders. Because the Aspirant badge Guinevere had made with her own hands and given to Vexana was still resonating with the full light of hope from the other badge in her own hand!

texts.title: Re:Link
texts.summary: The Mother Matrix descends on Planet Dawnbreak, and Vexana and Guinevere charge it together.

blocks.x: The Ender Mother Matrix descended upon Planet Dawnbreak and launched a fatal attack at Guinevere in the midst of battle. Although Vexana had already resolved to use herself to detonate the Mother Matrix at the final moment, she still could not stand by and watch Guinevere fall into danger. Piloting an ender mecha suit, she blocked the powerful attack, exposing her identity in the process.

The Matrix then turned its attack toward Vexana. This time, Guinevere stood in front of her. Just like in countless battles before, they were the strongest partners, companions who could trust their backs to each other even in the depths of despair.

Guinevere and Vexana looked into each other's eyes, their hearts connected. The prophecy of humanity's bleak future would be rewritten by their joined hands! Transforming into two crossing, radiant stars, they charged toward the Mother Matrix with unwavering resolve.
They are Aspirants, and this is their mission: to let hope be the blade that severs despair!

atlas.name: Universe A5-01
atlas.text: In the beginning, there is nothing but a chaotic energy singularity, until one day, the Big Bang happens and the embryo of Universe A5-01 emerges. After zillions of years of inflation, Universe A5-01 reaches a relatively stable condition and begins to thrive under the guidance of "Balance" - the Will of the Cosmos.

more.text: Universe A5-01 has its own consciousness "Balance" from the very beginning of the Big Bang. But not all galaxies within it have a will of their own. The themes of the galaxies' wills are not exactly the same. To some galaxies, killing is everything, while some other ones hold a more peaceful idea such as surviving and thriving. But all in all, they all are checked and balanced by the Will of the Cosmos. Galaxy A-19 is relatively young galaxy in the cosmos but it is one of the galaxies that hold the same "balance" idea with the universe. A-19 and its fellow galaxies are called the "Enforcers", they believe they are destined to keep the universe balanced on behalf of the universe. In A-19, there is a planet called Dawnbreak, it forms its will 2.6 billion years after its birth.
more.head: Will of the Cosmos

atlas.name: Planet Dawnbreak
atlas.text: Planet Dawnbreak is a planet in Universe A5-01. It was born in the Galaxy A-19 of the Saintess Constellation billions of years ago. In its early ages, it is full of nitrogen and its surface diurnal temperature variation is extreme, no life form can survive. Eons of asteroid and meteor impact greatly enrich the resources on the planet and bring plankton to the world. The planktons change the structure of the atmosphere bit by bit and after billions of years, all kinds of lifeforms emerge.

atlas.name: Planet Oro
atlas.text: Planet Oro is a planet in Universe A5-01. It was born in the Galaxy A-20 of the Aquila Constellation billions of years ago. The will of A-20 is "Balance", the same as the universe. It was a nitrogen gas planet in its early years. After billions of years of microbial action, it is now habitable planet.

atlas.name: Storm Citadel
atlas.text: The Storm Citadel is a colossal Enders mothership, sent to crush humanity's resistance once and for all. Concealed within storm clouds, it can unleash devastating electromagnetic interference over large areas.

atlas.name: Terrinia
atlas.text: To fight back against destruction, humanity reverse-engineered the wreckage of The Enders, developing mecha driven by humanity's hope and training the "Aspirants" capable of facing The Ender's head-on. Terrinia became humanity's final bastion.

atlas.name: Selrick Academy
atlas.text: The only academy that cultivates Aspirants in Terrinia. Its Elite Educational philosophy only allows children around 14 years old with an outstanding force of faith to enter its preparatory course for cultivation.

more.text: Within the city stands Selrick Academy, a place where young warriors are trained to pilot these miracle mecha. They are humanity's sharpest blade, and its last hope.
more.head: Selrick Academy

atlas.text: The only academy that cultivates Aspirants in Terrinia. Its Elite Educational philosophy only allows children around 14 years old with an outstanding force of faith to enter its preparatory course for cultivation.

more.head: Selrick Academy

atlas.name: The Aspirants
atlas.text: The Aspirants are gifted individuals trained to defend humanity from The Enders. They pilot advanced mecha using Aspirant power to safeguard the last human cities and ultimately reclaim their planet.

atlas.name: The Council
atlas.text: A venue for the three powers, Decisionmakers, the Institute of Technology, and the Beau Monde, to hold important meetings or pep rallies about Androids.

atlas.name: Training Field
atlas.text: A training venue exclusive for Androids to improve their combat capability.

atlas.name: Energy System
atlas.text: A landmark building in Terrinia that provides energy for the Defensive Bubble. It enwraps the whole city to resist the Ender's invasions.

atlas.name: Laboratory
atlas.text: Where Angela was born and where she receives Ruby's treatment whenever she gets injured in training.

atlas.name: The Garden
atlas.text: Ruby's and Angela's secret base with beautiful scenery.

atlas.name: Androids
atlas.text: Androids nicknamed "Cosmic Reapers" were born by Project "Angel".

atlas.name: The Enders
atlas.text: When a planet with the Will of Balance finds that the existence of a certain population is prosperous enough to endanger the survival of others, it will send the Enders to wreak havoc on it with the aim to achieve balance. The Enders, who usually appear near the target population, have a solid metal shell and expose their weak spots only when they launch attacks. The Enders don't strike easily. They represent the Will of the Planet, which enters a coma once the Enders are damaged. The Enders are classified into three ranks: Ultimate Enders, Super Enders, and Enders. Ultimate Enders can release Super Enders and Enders, which though not as lethal as the Ultimate Enders, are the main killing forces due to their large number.

atlas.name: Joe
atlas.text: A Combat Division instructor of Selrick Academy. The exclusive instructor of the Layla-Fanny Team.

atlas.name: Ruby's Father
atlas.text: As the leader of Decisionmakers, he is very strict with Ruby.

more.text: Ruby's father, ruler of Planet Oro. He once sent Angela and other androids to Planet Dawnbreak, a decision Ruby opposed.
more.head: Ruby's Father

atlas.name: AI Droids
atlas.text: Intelligent robots that can be seen everywhere in the Academy.

atlas.name: Support Division Trainee
atlas.text: Children who fail the entrance assessment will enter the Support Division. After one year's preparatory course, they will be divided into support teams in pairs, each for a certain Aspirant. The specialities of a support team's two members respectively lie in mecha repair and psychiatry repair.

atlas.name: Combat Division Trainee
atlas.text: Children who have passed the entrance assessment are eligible to take the Academy's introductory assessment, followed by the preparatory course of one year. They will then be divided into combat teams in pairs. Each combat team will be assigned an instructor who will arrange courses for them according to their aptitude.

atlas.name: Training Droids
atlas.text: Special droids used for Androids' combat training with a huge size.

atlas.name: Soldier of Planet Oro
atlas.text: The military force under the command of Decisionmakers. One of Oro's main forces.

atlas.name: Tetra
atlas.text: A gift for Angela from Ruby. Angela takes it with her wherever she is.

people.name: Fanny
people.text: Born into a military family, Fanny chose to delay her enrollment at sixteen to temper herself on real battlefields. She has never thought of hard work as something that needs to be hidden. Though she arrived at Selrick Academy two years after Layla, she broke Layla's undefeated record in her very first assessment. To Fanny, it was no big deal, but Layla saw it differently. But rankings can always wait. Whenever The Enders attack, the two always stand together without needing to say a word.
people.blurb: A third-year transfer student at the Selrick Academy, Layla's classmate and teammate. Born into a family of military officers, this fighter trains relentlessly to hone personal combat skills and has always fought to protect humanity.

people.name: Layla
people.text: Born into a family of technologist, Layla is recognized as a genius at Selrick Academy, though behind that genius lie countless secret late night training sessions. She hates letting others see how hard she works, yet more than anyone, she longs to be seen. Fanny took her place at the top, becoming her first true rival. As for whether that makes them friends... Layla still hasn't made up her mind.
people.blurb: A third-year student at Selrick Academy, Fanny's classmate and teammate. Loves tinkering with gear in a secret workshop and diving into all sorts of quirky research. Enjoys teasing transfer student Fanny during daily training, always striving to reclaim first place.

people.name: Ruby
people.text: Ruby was the daughter of Planet Oro's ruling class, raised from a young age as their successor. She was perfectly courteous and never said anything more than necessary-but all of it was nothing more than a carefully stitched disguise, hiding the defection plan she had been preparing for a long time. She secretly altered Angela's code, all to leave herself a way out. But she never expected that the innocent soul she awakened place by piece would ultimately become a bond she could no longer let go of.
people.blurb: Born to one of Planet Oro's decision-makers, she was closely guarded and raised as their successor, despite her yearning for freedom. Elegant and endearing, yet lively and free-spirited at heart, she later joined The Aspirants alongside Angela.

more.name: Ruby's Father
more.text: Ruby's father, ruler of Planet Oro. He once sent Angela and other androids to Planet Dawnbreak, a decision Ruby opposed.

people.name: Angela
people.text: As the pinnacle of Planet Oro's technology, Angela never had a true childhood from the moment she was born. She never longed for power, yet she was born as the sharpest blade. It was not until the warmth of Planet Dawnbreak showed her another possibility that, from that moment on, this blade began to develop a will of her own.
people.blurb: An android with a pure, innocent heart, yet deceived. The pinnacle of technology on Planet Oro in the A-20 System, and a core member of the Balance Keepers on Planet Oro, later becoming one of The Aspirants on Planet Dawnbreak.

people.name: Lesley
people.text: Lesley lost her left eye protecting her younger brother, and stepped onto the battlefield for revenge. With her extraordinary talent for shooting, she became the Chief Combat Instructor of Selrick Academy. With the prosthetic eye and giant sniper rifle developed by Chang'e, she became the strongest sharpshooter, protecting this planet left scarred by the arrival of The Enders.
people.blurb: A cold, aloof, and independent hunter. The more deeply she cares for someone, the harder she finds it to get close to them. An older-sister figure who struggles to express her true feelings, she serves as the head instructor of the Combat Division at Selrick Academy.

people.name: Chang'e
people.text: Though Chang'e is the director of the Science Division, she wears a children's style white lab coat. Small as she is, she holds the wisdom to shake the future. Her parents died in a surprise attack by The Enders. That grief anger became the drive that pushed her to work day and night, eventually becoming Chief Scientist and being put in charge of the core technology that would one day be used to strike back against The Enders.
people.blurb: Longs to grow up, relies on Lesley, and loves sweets, especially pudding, but hates taking medicine. Skilled at designing advanced tech weapons and the chief doctor of the Science Division at the Selrick Academy.

more.name: Chang'e Mother
more.text: Chang'e's mother, the chief scientist, once co-invented the Aspirant mecha suit with Chang'e.

more.name: Chang'e Father
more.text: Chang'e's father, the chief scientist, once co-invented the Aspirant mecha suit with Chang'e.

people.name: Guinevere
people.text: As the heir to a financial conglomerate, Guinevere rejected the fate arranged for her: taking over the family business and accepting the shackles known as wealth and power. She trained with everything she had and earned the academy's top score, only to be scolded by her father for neglecting her proper path. Then, on the day partners were chosen, Vexana stood up for her. After Vexana went missing, Guinevere remained convinced she was still alive, because the badge carrying their shared belief had never gone out...
people.blurb: Heiress to a top conglomerate and the ace student of the Combat Division. An independent girl who refuses to inherit the family business, aiming to become the top Aspirant.

more.name: Guinevere's Father
more.text: Guinevere's father, head of House Baroque and one of the decision-makers of the family conglomerate. He has continued to express disappointment in Guinevere for neglecting the family business in favor of her obsession with combat. (Not yet featured in the main storyline.).

people.name: Vexana
people.text: Burdened by a heavy past, Vexana had no friends until Guinevere entered her life and formed the strongest combat duo with her. During one mission, Vexana came face-to-face with the Will of the Planet. She was not corrupted. Instead, her final hope erupted from within she would step into the darkness and endure terrible pain, protecting the world for Guinevere in her own way!
people.blurb: Former Aspirant and ace of the Combat Division. Now a solitary guardian wandering in the darkness, silently protecting Guinevere, having turned her back on the Academy.

people.name: Obsidia
people.text: Obsidia is an ancient high-ranking Ender with the Storm Citadel as her throne and the entire planet as her chessboard. She has witnessed the birth and fall of countless civilizations, yet she has always waited for an answer the Mother Matrix could never give her. The board has been set, and the pieces have already turned against her. To Obsidia, however the game was finally becoming interesting.
people.blurb: A commander-type Ender born from the Void. She accompanies the Enders' Mother Matrix, receiving her guidance and healing. Though her ultimate goal is to destroy human civilization, she has her own considerations: if the planet is completely "cleansed", what fate awaits the Enders? She wants to be prepared for it.

people.name: Selena
people.text: Selena has lived at Selrick Academy as a genius to this day. She belongs neither to humanity nor to her own kind, walking between both worlds for the sake of her own freedom. When the shackles of her past began to tighten, Selena resolutely set out on a path of defiance for the sake of freedom!
people.blurb: A highly mobile Ender who grew up in human society. Knowing from a young age that she was different from humans and unable to emotionally connect with them, she cleverly concealed her uniqueness. While she holds no affection for human civilization, she does not blindly follow The Enders either. She is a morally ambiguous character.
